title: brossaea bracteata
intro: Brossaea bracteata, commonly known as "monkey bread", is a plant species belonging to the family Melastomataceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Brossaea bracteata include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation, as well as fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Brossaea bracteata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
